title: PDF imposition tools by workflow
selection_method: Task-specific editorial selections from official documentation, with access restrictions and alternatives; not a comparative performance benchmark.
verification_scope: Public documentation and original example arithmetic; no authenticated product export or comparative production test.

tools.name: PDFImpose
limitations: Templates and recent jobs are stored locally; cloud sync is not yet available.
Production-ticket output requires validation against the target equipment; current ticket exports describe front surfaces.

tools.name: JustImpose
limitations: N-up is a regular grid, not arbitrary-shape nesting.
Each PDF contributes all its imported pages, not one cell per file.
Front/back pairing and final-size scaling need a physical proof.

tools.name: FastImpose
tools.account_requirement: Google sign-in required for current Mac downloads; trial registration itself is described as requiring no account or card.

trial.registration: online, once per app per computer

limitations: Windows and Linux current installers are pending on the download page.
Internet is required for licence activation and deactivation; the activated application works offline.
Pro, Stickers and VDP are separate product routes; do not assume licence bundling.

tools.name: PDFPress
limitations: Marks can enlarge the outer page; check that the output fits the production sheet.
Local artwork processing is separate from online account and billing services.
Bleed repair and marks require visual and dimensional review.

tools.name: Quite Imposing Plus / Quite HOT Imposing

product_distinctions.quite-imposing-plus: Adobe Acrobat plug-in; full supported Acrobat required, not Reader

limitations: Do not treat the Acrobat plug-in and standalone automation product as interchangeable.
Check current OS and Acrobat compatibility.

tools.name: Montax Imposer
limitations: Free edition has a final sheet-size restriction.
Check the exact edition for variable-data and automation requirements.

tools.name: Imposition Wizard
tools.acrobat_requirement: Optional plug-in; standalone mode does not require Acrobat
limitations: Numbering and variable data are assigned to the separate Ticket Wizard product.

tools.name: BookletCreator
limitations: Narrow PDF-to-booklet product scope; advanced prepress or automation claims were not verified.
